BrochureContent.Content:
Gary O'Driscoll & Co are delighted to present this superb three-bedroom detached bungalow, ideally located on Doon Road, Ballybunion, Co. Kerry. Situated within walking distance of Ballybunion town centre and the popular Ladies Beach, this well-maintained residence offers a fantastic opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in one of North Kerry's most sought-after coastal locations.

The property enjoys an excellent setting adjacent to local schools and is within easy reach of all the amenities Ballybunion has to offer, including shops, cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities and its world-renowned beaches and golf courses.

Presented in good condition throughout, the home benefits from woodgrain PVC double-glazed windows and doors together with oil-fired central heating. The accommodation is bright, spacious and well-appointed, offering comfortable living space ideal for families, retirees or those seeking a coastal residence with convenience on their doorstep

Externally, the property boasts a tarmac driveway providing ample off-street parking to the front, while to the rear there is a generous south-facing garden, offering excellent privacy and enjoying sunlight throughout the day. This outdoor space is perfect for entertaining, gardening or simply relaxing in a peaceful setting.

Internally, the accommodation briefly consists of:

:Entrance Hallway: 6.48 x 2.18

Sitting Room: 5.48 x 3.94

Kitchen / Dining Room: 3.78 x 7.33

Utility Room: 2.19 x 2.50

Corridor: 6.00 x 1.16

Bedroom 1: 3.25 x 3.44

En-Suite: 1.74 x 1.89

Walk-In Wardrobe: 1.22 x 1.61

Bedroom 2: 3.20 x 3.76

Bedroom 3: 3.25 x 3.00

Main Bathroom: 3.17 x 2.20

This is an exceptional opportunity to acquire a detached bungalow in a prime residential location, combining spacious accommodation, excellent outdoor space and unrivalled convenience. 

Viewing is highly recommended.
